dang po ni nyan rang ma yin gyi byang chub sems dpa' yin no ||
gnyis pa ni rgyun du zhugs pa la sogs par gsung pa de dngos ming ngam btags ming gang yin zhe na | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4294">khyung po</rs> btags ming du 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de byang chub sems dpa' yin pa dang | rgyun du zhugs pa la sogs pa yin pa mi 'gal bas dngos la gnod byed med pa'i phyir ro || </seg></TEI>
